purpose: Document the native hermes_local/MiniMax-M3 runtime contract gap that prevents S03 / T03 condition t02_bos_result_present from being satisfied, and the native remediation boundary that must be crossed to close it.

contract.required_for_t03: per-agent condition t02_bos_result_present (C7) — 7 of 7 agents must satisfy

runtime_observation.summary_field_is: text description of the diagnostic outcome (no JSON structure)
runtime_observation.contextSnapshot_is: Paperclip runtime context (does NOT contain bos-light-v1 schema)
runtime_observation.triggerDetail_is: trigger metadata (does NOT contain bos-light-v1 schema)
runtime_observation.stdoutExcerpt_is: raw stdout from hermes process (does NOT contain bos-light-v1 schema)
runtime_observation.stderrExcerpt_is: raw stderr from hermes process (does NOT contain bos-light-v1 schema)
runtime_observation.usageJson_is: token-usage metadata (does NOT contain bos-light-v1 schema)

native_remediation_boundary.description: The bos-light-v1 schema contract requires hermes_local/MiniMax-M3 to emit structured JSON output at resultJson.bos. The native runtime emits a freeform reasoning trace at resultJson.result + resultJson.summary instead. The contract gap is at the adapter/instruction boundary, NOT at the readback or polling boundary.
native_remediation_boundary.must_be_fixed_at: one or more of the following layers (each is a runtime-side change — out of S03 scope):

candidate_remediation_sites.what_would_change: post-process MiniMax-M3 output to inject resultJson.bos with schemaVersion, runId, division, role, status before returning to Paperclip
instruct the model to emit resultJson.bos schema in its structured output channel (not in reasoning trace)
candidate_remediation_sites.owned_by: Paperclip agent instructions / MiniMax-M3 prompt engineering

candidate_remediation_sites.what_would_change: rewrite the agent instructions bundle so hermes_local wraps the model output in resultJson.bos before returning
configure MiniMax-M3 structured-output API to emit JSON conforming to bos-light-v1 schema
candidate_remediation_sites.owned_by: Paperclip runtime / MiniMax-M3 model provider integration

native_remediation_boundary.s03_cannot_remediate: S03 is an observation/probe layer. It can only READ state from Paperclip + hermes_local. S03 has no authority to modify adapter code, instruction bundles, or model configuration — those require changes upstream of the readback boundary.

t03_impact.upstream_status_fail_reason: T02.status=FAIL_CLOSED because bos-light-v1 schema is absent

s04_admission_decision.reason: S03 gate is fail-closed at 40/49 conditions with 3/4 global gates failing on the UPSTREAM-STATUS gate (because T02 status=FAIL_CLOSED). S04 admission requires the S03 49/49 AND 4/4 gates to pass. Native runtime contract must be remediated upstream (see candidate_remediation_sites) before S04 admission is possible. T11 itself cannot pass S03 without weakening the bos-light-v1 schema guard, which is explicitly forbidden by the task plan.
